reviews.text: We had a terrific experience with Texas Traditions! We got 8 different estimates to renovate our backyard and pool, and Texas Traditions was the only one that was able to deliver all of our wants and stay within our budget. Gil was a fantastic project manager and great communicator. Our project was very extensive and was completed in about 2 months. Just one small complaint...we have a footprint in the concrete of the pool deck that was never fixed. I think this was mainly an issue with the concrete subcontractor never coming back out to address it despite Gil contacting them multiple times. Overall a great experience!
reviews.author: Andrew Shipley

reviews.text: We ABSOLUTELY LOVE our new patio done by Texas Traditions! Gil and his team did an outstanding job and we are so grateful! We went from nothing in the backyard to something that we use everyday; from Sunday naps to family dinners. We even added a concrete pad on the side for storage and to hide our trashcans. We are enjoying our beautiful new space. THANK YOU SO MUCH!
reviews.author: Loresha Worley

reviews.text: We are so happy with our pool from Texas Tradtions! We worked with Gil as our project manager and I have nothing but great things to say about him, his service, follow up and continued support. He was diligent, easy to work with, knowledgeable and thorough. He really made the process easy. The pool itself has been used to it's fullest, the products they sell are super easy to use, they connect to my smart home, and really make our yard pop! I highly recommend Gil and the team he has at Texas Traditions!
reviews.author: Ethan F

reviews.text:
Gil came to our house in October to give a quote for a cabana and kitchen.  He was helpful and showed us a project that looked great.  We thought they’d be a great option. He said he’d give us a quote by the end of the next week, but he didn’t.  We never heard from him.
Apparently they don’t need new business.  Would have appreciated a follow-up to let us know they didn’t want to work with us.
reviews.author: Melizabeth A.

reviews.text: Our experience with Texas Traditions was excellent! Gil and his team did an amazing job, start to finish. The pool, patio and cabana building project we hired them to complete was managed professionally and thoroughly. Any concerns or questions have been promptly addressed, and Gil’s above-and-beyond support has been greatly appreciated. A high level of customer care is what one would hope for in a major investment like this, and we got that and more. Thank you for the outstanding work and service. We love our new backyard!
reviews.author: Robert

reviews.text: We hired Texas Traditions to remodel our pool as our original builder did not do the best job. We worked with Gil to change our coping to travertine, repair some tiles and replace the mastic. He and his crew did a phenomenal job! Grateful to my friend/neighbor that hired them and connected me with Gil. I highly recommend this company for a new pool build or remodel!
reviews.author: Lexy Elmer

reviews.text: Gil and his team were phenomenal through the entire process. They listened to us through the design process and provided multiple options to better fit our budget. Gil has also been more than helpful post completion! He has always picked up his phone and answered questions or made a visit to ensure all is well. The level of detail and care you'll find within this company is something you won't receive everywhere! I would definitely recommend this company to family and friends! Thanks for all the help Gil, you built us the pool we've always wanted!!
reviews.author: Kevin Macdonald

reviews.text: We worked with Gil and despite some issues I must say he was great from start to finish. TTO did an excellent job; build a beautiful pool, perfectly updated our patio and landscaping. We had some downturns and construction issues but Gil managed to fulfill its promise. Furthermore Gil was very responsive after project completion. Would highly recommend TTO and Gil to anyone.
reviews.author: Tom L
